nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: How does living in a rural area affect consumer behaviour in terms of ethical consumption according to Carrigan and Attala (2001)?
nodes.answer: Living in a rural area may act as a barrier to ethical consumption due to the effort involved in going to town.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Eco-conscious consumerism|Locally sourced goods_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How does living in a rural area impact shopping habits, particularly in relation to online shops?
nodes.answer: Living in a rural area may lead individuals to rely more on online shops, which can offer a wider range of sustainable options beyond just high street shops.
